1. Parse the independent instance, grid, attempt/demo caps, counters, and allowed actions. Treat the demo as evidence about the transformation, not as a template for color substitution: derive the rule from aligned input/output cells, including background and all marker colors, and check whether the demonstrated relation actually applies to the test before constructing an output.
